title: Replace dict.get() with direct indexing for enum mappings
description: In python/src/lichen/, find all dict.get(enum_value, default) patterns where the dict maps enum variants to strings/values and ALL variants should be covered. Replace .get(key, default) with dict[key] so missing variants raise KeyError. Primary target: _ORIGIN_REJECT_TO_REASON in dao_manager.py. Grep for similar patterns in other files. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest -x
